title: Equalizer
description: JSON Schema for an equalizer — the universal cone over a parallel pair (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §3; Awodey 2010 §5.4). Given two morphisms f, g : A → B, the equalizer is an object E with a morphism e : E → A such that f ∘ e = g ∘ e, and universal among such pairs: any other (Q, q) with f ∘ q = g ∘ q factors uniquely through E.

parallel-pair.description: The parallel pair f, g : A → B — two morphisms with the same domain and same codomain. The schema enforces exactly two; the same-domain-same-codomain condition is checked by a separate transformer.

equalizing-morphism.description: The morphism e : E → A satisfying f ∘ e = g ∘ e.
